comment: If you've taken/understood calc before, take him and it'll be your easiest class. As a professor, he shouldn't be teaching. Regularly got problems on the board wrong, slowest person you've ever seen, seems like he might keel over walking.

I could do all of my problems online in class and ask him to explain those that I could not solve after class. Be ready to take notes because he includes those problems that he wrote on the board in his exams.

I personally loved this professor. I will admit that he moves rather slowly but he is clear and concise with feedback. The teacher really cares about the students and teaches in a way that makes learning the material easy rather than writing it on the board and leaving you to teach yourself. TAKE THIS CLASS TO FULFILL GEN-ED!

Honestly, if you want to sit in class with the human incarnation of a sloth, then by all means, take Calculus with this guy. I learned absolutely nothing in class for three reasons: he explains nothing, he talks at an unintelligible volume, and he writes microscopically. This was the worst class I've ever taken. I had to learn everything on my own.
